scripts.script:
-- =========================================================
-- 🎃 T88 HUB v84.1 - HALLOWEEN EDITION (SEM KEY) 🎃
-- Auto Cristal + Abóbora + Beber + Comer + ESP + Attack
-- =========================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local LINK_DO_DISCORD = "https://discord.gg/9xAJDuR8z"

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(300) do
        pcall(function()
            VirtualUser:CaptureController()
            VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
        end)
    end
end)

LP.Idled:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        VirtualUser:CaptureController()
        VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
    end)
end)

local function iniciarHub()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

    local Config = {
        espPlayer = false, espVida = true, espDistancia = false, raioEsp = 300,
        autoAttack = false, raioAttack = 10,
        intervaloAtaque = 1.0,
        anguloLimite = 60,
        autoCristal = false, autoAbobora = false, autoBeber = false, autoComer = false,
        qualidadeMinima = 0.7,
        priorizarHotsprings = true,
        metaComer = 0.7,
        metaBeber = 0.95,
        velocidadeVoo = 200, raioRegiao = 900, tempoMaxRegiao = 12,
        prioridadeComerBeber = 0.6,
    }

    local totalAbobora = 0
    local totalColetado = 0
    local totalBebeu = 0
    local totalComeu = 0
    local indiceRegiaoAbobora = 1
    local indiceRegiaoAtual = 1
    local ultimaVarredura = 0

    local ocupado = false
    local quemTaOcupado = nil
    local tempoLock = 0
    local lockToken = 0

    local function pegarLock(quem)
        if ocupado then
            if tick() - tempoLock > 25 then
                ocupado = false; quemTaOcupado = nil; lockToken = lockToken + 1
            else return false end
        end
        ocupado = true; quemTaOcupado = quem; tempoLock = tick(); lockToken = lockToken + 1
        print("[T88] 🔒 " .. quem)
        return lockToken
    end

    local function liberarLock(token)
        if token and token ~= lockToken then return end
        if quemTaOcupado then print("[T88] 🔓 " .. quemTaOcupado) end
        ocupado = false; quemTaOcupado = nil; tempoLock = 0
    end

    local function tenhoLock(token) return ocupado and token == lockToken end
    local function forcarLiberacao() ocupado = false; quemTaOcupado = nil; lockToken = lockToken + 1 end

    local function getHRP()
        local char = LP.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local attackRemote = nil
    task.spawn(function()
        local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        if remotes then
            local combat = remotes:WaitForChild("Combat", 10)
            if combat then attackRemote = combat:WaitForChild("Attack", 10) end
        end
    end)

    local TryConsume = nil
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
            if remotes then
                local controls = remotes:WaitForChild("Controls", 10)
                if controls then TryConsume = controls:WaitForChild("TryConsume", 10) end
            end
        end)
    end)

    local function acharBotaoAtaque()
        for _, g in ipairs({LP.PlayerGui.TouchGui, LP.PlayerGui.Touchscreen}) do
            if g then
                for _, obj in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                        local nome = string.lower(obj.Name)
                        if string.find(nome, "attack") or string.find(nome, "punch")
                           or string.find(nome, "claw") or string.find(nome, "bite")
                           or string.find(nome, "strike") then return obj end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local botaoAtaque = acharBotaoAtaque()

    local function acharBarra(nome)
        local hud = LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Hud")
        if not hud then return nil end
        local bottom = hud:FindFirstChild("BottomContainer")
        local statsF = bottom and bottom:FindFirstChild("Stats")
        local content = statsF and statsF:FindFirstChild("StatsContent")
        local botBox = content and content:FindFirstChild("BotBox")
        if not botBox then return nil end
        return botBox:FindFirstChild(nome)
    end

    local function lerPorcentagem(barra)
        if not barra then return nil end
        local bar = barra:FindFirstChild("Bar")
        if bar and bar:IsA("Frame") then return bar.Size.X.Scale end
        for _, filho in ipairs(barra:GetChildren()) do
            if filho:IsA("Frame") then return filho.Size.X.Scale end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function urgenciaComerBeber()
        if Config.autoBeber then
            local sede = lerPorcentagem(acharBarra("Water"))
            if sede and sede < Config.prioridadeComerBeber then return "sede" end
        end
        if Config.autoComer then
            local fome = lerPorcentagem(acharBarra("Food"))
            if fome and fome < Config.prioridadeComerBeber then return "fome" end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function getPos(obj)
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj.Position end
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            local ok, p = pcall(function() return obj:GetPivot().Position end)
            if ok then return p end
        end
        local p = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if p then return p.Position end
        return nil
    end

    -- 🛠️ Desencalha o dino (SÓ IMPULSO FÍSICO, zero teleporte)
    local function desencalhar(posAlvo, bv)
        local h = getHRP()
        if not h then return end
        
        if bv then
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 500, 0)
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
        
        local h2 = getHRP()
        if h2 and h2.Position.Y < posAlvo.Y - 5 then
            if bv then
                local dirXZ = Vector3.new(
                    posAlvo.X - h2.Position.X, 0,
                    posAlvo.Z - h2.Position.Z
                )
                if dirXZ.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                    dirXZ = dirXZ.Unit
                    bv.Velocity = dirXZ * 50 + Vector3.new(0, 600, 0)
                else
                    bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 600, 0)
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end

    local function voarAtePerto(posAlvo, token)
        local DISTANCIA = 3
        local MAX_TENTATIVAS = 5
        local TEMPO_POR_TENTATIVA = 15
        for tentativa = 1, MAX_TENTATIVAS do
            if token and not tenhoLock(token) then return false end
            local hrp = getHRP()
            if not hrp then return false end
            if (hrp.Position - posAlvo).Magnitude <= DISTANCIA then return true end
            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bv.Parent = hrp
            local inicio = tick()
            local ultimaPos = hrp.Position
            local tempoParado = 0
            while tick() - inicio < TEMPO_POR_TENTATIVA do
                local h = getHRP()
                if not h then break end
                if token and not tenhoLock(token) then bv:Destroy(); return false end
                local dist = (h.Position - posAlvo).Magnitude
                if dist <= DISTANCIA then
                    bv:Destroy()
                    pcall(function()
                        h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    return true
                end
                local moveu = (h.Position - ultimaPos).Magnitude
                if moveu < 0.5 then tempoParado = tempoParado + 0.03 else tempoParado = 0 end
                ultimaPos = h.Position
                if tempoParado > 2 then
                    tempoParado = 0
                    desencalhar(posAlvo, bv)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
                local dir = (posAlvo - h.Position).Unit
                if dist < 50 then bv.Velocity = dir * 15
                else bv.Velocity = dir * Config.velocidadeVoo end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            bv:Destroy()
            pcall(function()
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
        return false
    end

    local function voarSemLock(posAlvo)
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return end
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bv.Parent = hrp
        local inicio = tick()
        local ultimaPos = hrp.Position
        local tempoParado = 0
        while tick() - inicio < 15 do
            local h = getHRP()
            if not h then break end
            local dist = (h.Position - posAlvo).Magnitude
            if dist <= 10 then break end
            local moveu = (h.Position - ultimaPos).Magnitude
            if moveu < 0.5 then tempoParado = tempoParado + 0.03 else tempoParado = 0 end
            ultimaPos = h.Position
            if tempoParado > 2 then
                tempoParado = 0
                desencalhar(posAlvo, bv)
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
            local dir = (posAlvo - h.Position).Unit
            if dist < 50 then bv.Velocity = dir * 20
            else bv.Velocity = dir * Config.velocidadeVoo end
            task.wait(0.03)
        end
        bv:Destroy()
        pcall(function()
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end

    local function voarAteComida(posComida, token)
        local OFFSET_Y = 6
        local RAIO_ACEITO = 6
        for tentativa = 1, 5 do
            if token and not tenhoLock(token) then return false end
            local hrp = getHRP()
            if not hrp then return false end
            if (hrp.Position - posComida).Magnitude <= RAIO_ACEITO then return true end
            local alvoVoo = posComida + Vector3.new(0, OFFSET_Y, 0)
            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bv.Parent = hrp
            local inicio = tick()
            local ultimaPos = hrp.Position
            local tempoParado = 0
            while tick() - inicio < 10 do
                local h = getHRP()
                if not h then break end
                if token and not tenhoLock(token) then bv:Destroy(); return false end
                local distAtual = (h.Position - posComida).Magnitude
                if distAtual <= RAIO_ACEITO then
                    bv:Destroy()
                    pcall(function()
                        h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    return true
                end
                local moveu = (h.Position - ultimaPos).Magnitude
                if moveu < 0.5 then tempoParado = tempoParado + 0.03 else tempoParado = 0 end
                ultimaPos = h.Position
                if tempoParado > 2 then
                    tempoParado = 0
                    desencalhar(posComida, bv)
                    task.wait(0.4)
                end
                if h.Position.Y < posComida.Y - 2 then
                    local dirXZ = Vector3.new(posComida.X - h.Position.X, 0, posComida.Z - h.Position.Z)
                    if dirXZ.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                        dirXZ = dirXZ.Unit
                        bv.Velocity = dirXZ * 40 + Vector3.new(0, 80, 0)
                    else
                        bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 80, 0)
                    end
                else
                    local dir = (alvoVoo - h.Position).Unit
                    if distAtual < 15 then bv.Velocity = dir * 12
                    else bv.Velocity = dir * Config.velocidadeVoo end
                end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            bv:Destroy()
            pcall(function()
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
        return false
    end

    -- AUTO ATTACK
    local ultimaMordida = 0
    local alvoAtual = nil

    local function acharAlvo()
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local melhorAlvo, menorDist = nil, Config.raioAttack
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local aHrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 and aHrp then
                    local d = (aHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < menorDist then menorDist = d; melhorAlvo = plr end
                end
            end
        end
        return melhorAlvo
    end

    local function calcularAngulo(posAlvo)
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return 180 end
        local direcaoAtual = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        local direcaoAlvo = (posAlvo - hrp.Position)
        if direcaoAlvo.Magnitude < 0.1 then return 0 end
        direcaoAlvo = direcaoAlvo.Unit
        local dot = direcaoAtual:Dot(direcaoAlvo)
        dot = math.clamp(dot, -1, 1)
        return math.deg(math.acos(dot))
    end

    local virando = false
    local function virarRapido(posAlvo)
        if virando then return end
        virando = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then virando = false; return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not humanoid then virando = false; return end
            
            pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = false end)
            
            local alvoVec = Vector3.new(posAlvo.X, hrp.Position.Y, posAlvo.Z)
            if (alvoVec - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 0.5 then
                pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
                virando = false
                return
            end
            
            local cframeAlvo = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, alvoVec)
            local cframeOriginal = hrp.CFrame
            
            for i = 1, 4 do
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.CFrame = cframeOriginal:Lerp(cframeAlvo, i / 4)
                end)
                task.wait(0.02)
            end
            
            pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
            virando = false
        end)
    end

    local function morder()
        if attackRemote then
            pcall(function() attackRemote:FireServer() end)
            pcall(function() attackRemote:FireServer() end)
        end
        if botaoAtaque then
            pcall(function()
                local pos = botaoAtaque.AbsolutePosition + botaoAtaque.AbsoluteSize / 2
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(pos.X, pos.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
                task.wait(0.03)
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(pos.X, pos.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
            end)
        end
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if char then
                local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool then tool:Activate() end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- BOTÃO FLUTUANTE 🎃
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "T88StrikeBtn"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100; gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local btnStrike = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btnStrike.Name = "BtnStrike"
    btnStrike.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 65)
    btnStrike.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 300)
    btnStrike.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 15, 40)
    btnStrike.Text = "🎃"
    btnStrike.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
    btnStrike.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btnStrike.TextSize = 25
    btnStrike.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btnStrike.AutoButtonColor = false
    btnStrike.Active = true
    btnStrike.ZIndex = 10
    btnStrike.Parent = gui

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); btnCorner.Parent = btnStrike
    local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
    btnStroke.Thickness = 2; btnStroke.Parent = btnStrike

    local arrastando, inicio, posInicial, moveu = false, Vector2.new(), UDim2.new(), false

    btnStrike.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            arrastando = true; moveu = false
            inicio = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
            posInicial = btnStrike.Position
        end
    end)

    btnStrike.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not arrastando then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local dx = input.Position.X - inicio.X
            local dy = input.Position.Y - inicio.Y
            if math.abs(dx) > 3 or math.abs(dy) > 3 then moveu = true end
            btnStrike.Position = UDim2.new(posInicial.X.Scale, posInicial.X.Offset + dx, posInicial.Y.Scale, posInicial.Y.Offset + dy)
        end
    end)

    btnStrike.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            arrastando = false
            btnStrike:SetAttribute("UltimoCliqueFoiArrasto", moveu)
        end
    end)

    btnStrike.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if btnStrike:GetAttribute("UltimoCliqueFoiArrasto") then
            btnStrike:SetAttribute("UltimoCliqueFoiArrasto", false); return
        end
        Config.autoAttack = not Config.autoAttack
        if Config.autoAttack then
            btnStrike.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            btnStrike.Text = "✅"
        else
            btnStrike.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
            btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
            btnStrike.Text = "🎃"
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.1) do
            if Config.autoAttack then
                local alvo = acharAlvo()
                if alvo and alvo.Character then
                    local aHrp = alvo.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if aHrp then
                        local angulo = calcularAngulo(aHrp.Position)
                        if angulo > Config.anguloLimite then
                            virarRapido(aHrp.Position)
                        end
                        local agora = tick()
                        if agora - ultimaMordida >= Config.intervaloAtaque then
                            ultimaMordida = agora
                            morder()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- ESP
    local espObjects = {}
    local function atualizarVida(dados, hum)
        if not dados.vidaFill or not hum then return end
        local hpPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
        dados.vidaFill.Size = UDim2.new(hpPct, 0, 1, 0)
        if hpPct > 0.6 then dados.vidaFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        elseif hpPct > 0.3 then dados.vidaFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
        else dados.vidaFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) end
        if dados.nomeLabel then dados.nomeLabel.Text = hum.Parent.Name .. " [" .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. "/" .. math.floor(hum.MaxHealth) .. "]" end
    end

    local function criarESP(plr)
        if plr == LP or not plr.Character then return end
        local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        if espObjects[plr] and espObjects[plr].box and espObjects[plr].box.Parent == hrp then return end
        if espObjects[plr] then
            if espObjects[plr].box then pcall(function() espObjects[plr].box:Destroy() end) end
            if espObjects[plr].billboard then pcall(function() espObjects[plr].billboard:Destroy() end) end
        end
        local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        box.Name = "T88_ESP_Box"; box.Size = Vector3.new(4, 6, 4)
        box.AlwaysOnTop = true; box.ZIndex = 5; box.Transparency = 0.4
        box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 0); box.Adornee = hrp; box.Parent = hrp; box.Visible = false
        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = "T88_ESP_Billboard"; billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 50)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0); billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Adornee = hrp; billboard.Parent = hrp; billboard.Enabled = false
        local nomeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nomeLabel.Name = "Nome"; nomeLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16); nomeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nomeLabel.Text = plr.Name; nomeLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
        nomeLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0; nomeLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        nomeLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; nomeLabel.TextSize = 12; nomeLabel.Parent = billboard
        local vidaBg = Instance.new("Frame")
        vidaBg.Name = "VidaBg"; vidaBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 6)

scripts.script:
-- Check for table that is shared between executions.
if not shared then
	return warn("No shared, no script.")
end

-- Detach previous instance.
if shared.SilentAim then
	shared.SilentAim.detach()
end

local SilentAim = {
	enabled = true,
	showFov = true,
	showHighlight = true,
	fovRadius = 200,
	targetPart = "Head",
	highlightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	target = nil,

	espEnabled = true,
	espBoxes = true,
	espNames = true,
	espHealth = true,
	espChams = true,
	espNonEnemies = false,
	espMaxDistance = 1500,
	teamColors = {
		Police = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 255),
		Prisoner = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
		Fugitive = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
	},
	defaultTeamColor = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
}

-- Constants.
local GUN_MODULE_NAME = "GunClient"

-- Services.
local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

local localPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer
local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- State.
local connections = {}
local espObjects = {}
local espFailed = {}
local espErrorLogged = false
local alive = true
local oldIndex = nil
local currentPart = nil
local rayfield = nil
local hiddenUi = gethui()
local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
local targetHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

fovCircle.NumSides = 64
fovCircle.Thickness = 1
fovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
fovCircle.Transparency = 1

targetHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
targetHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
targetHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
targetHighlight.Enabled = false
targetHighlight.Parent = hiddenUi

---Mirror the game's damage rules. Never call game code, it strips our capabilities.
---@param attackerTeam Team?
---@param victimTeam Team?
---@return boolean
local function canDamageTeam(attackerTeam, victimTeam)
	local attackerName = attackerTeam and attackerTeam.Name
	local victimName = victimTeam and victimTeam.Name

	if attackerName == "NoTeam" or victimName == "NoTeam" then
		return false
	end

	if attackerName == "Police" then
		return victimName ~= "Police"
	end

	if attackerName == "Prisoner" or attackerName == "Fugitive" then
		return victimName == "Police"
	end

	return true
end

---Get the color for a player's team.
---@param player Player
---@return Color3
local function getTeamColor(player)
	local team = player.Team
	if not team then
		return SilentAim.defaultTeamColor
	end

	return SilentAim.teamColors[team.Name] or team.TeamColor.Color
end

---Find the closest damageable enemy part to the cursor inside the FOV.
---@return BasePart?
local function getTargetPart()
	local closestPart, closestDistance = nil, SilentAim.fovRadius
	local mousePosition = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local localTeam = localPlayer.Team

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		if player == localPlayer then continue end
		if not canDamageTeam(localTeam, player.Team) then continue end

		local character = player.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(SilentAim.targetPart)
		if not (humanoid and part and humanoid.Health > 0) then continue end

		local screenPosition, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		if not onScreen then continue end

		local distance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - mousePosition).Magnitude
		if distance < closestDistance then
			closestDistance = distance
			closestPart = part
		end
	end

	return closestPart
end

---Create the chams and drawings for a player. Chams first so a parent failure leaks nothing.
---@param player Player
local function createEsp(player)
	local chams = Instance.new("Highlight")
	chams.FillTransparency = 0.75
	chams.OutlineTransparency = 0.3
	chams.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	chams.Enabled = false
	chams.Parent = hiddenUi

	local box = Drawing.new("Square")
	box.Thickness = 1
	box.Filled = false
	box.Transparency = 1

	local name = Drawing.new("Text")
	name.Size = 13
	name.Center = true
	name.Outline = true
	name.Transparency = 1

	local healthBar = Drawing.new("Line")
	healthBar.Thickness = 2
	healthBar.Transparency = 1

	espObjects[player] = { box = box, name = name, healthBar = healthBar, chams = chams }
end

---Hide every ESP element for a player.
---@param esp table
local function hideEsp(esp)
	esp.box.Visible = false
	esp.name.Visible = false
	esp.healthBar.Visible = false
	esp.chams.Enabled = false
	esp.chams.Adornee = nil
end

---Destroy a player's ESP.
---@param player Player
local function destroyEsp(player)
	espFailed[player] = nil

	local esp = espObjects[player]
	if not esp then return end

	espObjects[player] = nil
	esp.box:Remove()
	esp.name:Remove()
	esp.healthBar:Remove()
	esp.chams:Destroy()
end

---Update a player's ESP for this frame.
---@param player Player
---@param esp table
local function updateEsp(player, esp)
	if not SilentAim.espEnabled then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	if not SilentAim.espNonEnemies and not canDamageTeam(localPlayer.Team, player.Team) then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local distance = (currentCamera.CFrame.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > SilentAim.espMaxDistance then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local rootScreen, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
	if not onScreen then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local color = getTeamColor(player)
	local topScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	local bottomScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
	local height = math.abs(topScreen.Y - bottomScreen.Y)
	local width = height / 1.8
	local left = rootScreen.X - width / 2

	esp.box.Visible = SilentAim.espBoxes
	esp.box.Color = color
	esp.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
	esp.box.Position = Vector2.new(left, topScreen.Y)

	esp.name.Visible = SilentAim.espNames
	esp.name.Color = color
	esp.name.Text = string.format("%s [%dm]", player.Name, math.floor(distance))
	esp.name.Position = Vector2.new(rootScreen.X, topScreen.Y - 16)

	local healthRatio = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
	esp.healthBar.Visible = SilentAim.espHealth
	esp.healthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), healthRatio)
	esp.healthBar.From = Vector2.new(left - 4, topScreen.Y + height)
	esp.healthBar.To = Vector2.new(left - 4, topScreen.Y + height - height * healthRatio)

	esp.chams.Enabled = SilentAim.espChams
	esp.chams.Adornee = character
	esp.chams.FillColor = color
	esp.chams.OutlineColor = color
end

---Detach the hooks, drawings and menu.
function SilentAim.detach()
	alive = false

	if oldIndex then
		hookmetamethod(game, "__index", oldIndex)
		oldIndex = nil
	end

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	for player in pairs(espObjects) do
		destroyEsp(player)
	end

	fovCircle:Remove()
	targetHighlight:Destroy()

	if rayfield then
		rayfield:Destroy()
	end

	shared.SilentAim = nil
end

---Build the Rayfield menu.
local function createMenu()
	local response = request({ Url = "https://sirius.menu/rayfield", Method = "GET" })
	rayfield = loadstring(response.Body)()

	aimTab:CreateKeybind({

-- Configuration

local ENEMY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)    -- Red for enemies
local FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.5

-- Game Verification

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Verify game and device
local function verifyAccess()
    -- Check if it's the Afghanistan game
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    
    if placeId ~= ALLOWED_PLACE_ID then
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
        return false
    end
    
    -- Check if on PC/Laptop (not mobile/tablet)
    local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    
    -- Check if touch is enabled (mobile/tablet)
    if userInputService.TouchEnabled then
        -- Additional check: if it's a touch device AND has small screen, it's mobile
        local screenSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if screenSize.X <= 1200 then
            LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
            return false
        end
    end
    
    -- Check for mobile-specific features
    local isMobile = false
    
    -- Check platform type
    local platform = userInputService:GetPlatform()
    if platform == Enum.Platform.Android or platform == Enum.Platform.IOS then
        isMobile = true
    end
    
    -- Check for mobile-only UI
    if not isMobile and userInputService.GamepadEnabled then
        -- Could be a console or mobile with gamepad
        if userInputService.TouchEnabled then
            isMobile = true
        end
    end
    
    if isMobile then
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

-- Check if we have access

local espInstances = {}

-- Function to completely clean up a player's ESP
local function cleanupESP(player)
    if not player then return end
    
    local espData = espInstances[player]
    if not espData then return end
    
    -- Disconnect all connections for this player
    if espData.connections then

                conn:Disconnect()

        espData.connections = {}
    end
    
    -- Destroy highlight if it exists

            espData.highlight:Destroy()

        espData.highlight = nil
    end
    
    -- Destroy all GUI elements

    end
    
    -- Clear all other references
    espData.healthBar = nil
    espData.healthFill = nil
    espData.nameLabel = nil

    espData.humanoid = nil

    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

    return screenGui, healthBar, healthFill, nameLabel

-- Get team color for a player
local function getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return TEAM_COLOR
    end
    
    -- Try to get team from various systems
    local team = player.Team
    if team then
        if player.Neutral then
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) -- Yellow for neutral
        end
        
        -- Compare team colors
        local localTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
        if localTeam and team == localTeam then
            return TEAM_COLOR
        else
            return ENEMY_COLOR
        end
    end
    
    -- Fallback: check for TeamService
    local teamService = game:GetService("Teams")
    local localTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
    if localTeam then
        for _, t in ipairs(teamService:GetTeams()) do
            if t == team then
                if t == localTeam then
                    return TEAM_COLOR
                else
                    return ENEMY_COLOR
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- If no team system, use player color
    return ENEMY_COLOR
end

-- Set up ESP for a player's character
local function setupCharacterESP(player, character)
    if not player or not character or not ESP_ENABLED then return end
    
    -- Clean up any existing ESP for this player first
    cleanupESP(player)
    
    -- Create Highlight
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
    highlight.FillTransparency = FILL_TRANSPARENCY
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY
    highlight.FillColor = getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    highlight.OutlineColor = getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    highlight.Parent = character
    
    -- Create health bar
    local screenGui, healthBar, healthFill, nameLabel = createHealthBar(player)
    
    -- Store instances
    local espData = {
        highlight = highlight,
        screenGui = screenGui,
        healthBar = healthBar,
        healthFill = healthFill,
        nameLabel = nameLabel,
        character = character,
        humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),
        connections = {}
    }
    
    espInstances[player] = espData
    
    -- Create update connection
    local updateConn
    updateConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not ESP_ENABLED then return end
        if not espInstances[player] then return end
        if not espData.character then return end
        if not espData.character.Parent then
            cleanupESP(player)
            return
        end
        
        local rootPart = espData.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = espData.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if rootPart and humanoid then
            local head = espData.character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local screenPos, onScreen = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                if onScreen then
                    espData.healthBar.Visible = true
                    espData.healthBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenPos.X - 25, 0, screenPos.Y)
                    
                    local healthPercent = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
                    espData.healthFill.Size = UDim2.new(healthPercent, 0, 1, 0)
                    
                    if healthPercent > 0.5 then
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                    elseif healthPercent > 0.25 then
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                    else
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    end
                    
                    espData.nameLabel.Text = player.Name
                else
                    espData.healthBar.Visible = false
                end
            else
                espData.healthBar.Visible = false
            end
        else
            espData.healthBar.Visible = false
        end
    end)
    
    table.insert(espData.connections, updateConn)
    
    -- Clean up when character dies
    if espData.humanoid then
        local diedConn = espData.humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.1)
            cleanupESP(player)
        end)
        table.insert(espData.connections, diedConn)
    end
    
    -- Clean up when character is removed
    local removedConn = character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if not character.Parent then
            task.wait(0.1)
            cleanupESP(player)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(espData.connections, removedConn)
end

-- Create ESP for a player
local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local charAddedConn
    charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.5) -- Wait for character to load

    -- Check if character already exists
